name: Maria Chen
psychographics: Values time-saving over cost-saving; pragmatic about money but hates feeling rushed
current_solutions: Grocery shopping via Iceland online; Kids' clothes from ASOS sale and local uniform shop; Budgeting app: Emma
frustration: Tried to cancel her Amazon Prime subscription at 11:42 PM on a Tuesday; the 'cancel membership' button was greyed out and she was stuck in a loop for 22 minutes before raising a dispute with her bank
decision_style: Compares price per unit on her phone while standing in the supermarket aisle; rarely buys anything without checking at least two supermarkets' apps first
voice: Brisk and direct; switches between explaining a school pickup schedule and muttering about 'the state of energy prices'
